**Repeat suppression is in.** 99 repeats dropped, zero errors.

A key delivered within 5 minutes drops. Only real deliveries start the window, so a dropped repeat does not extend it. `critical` is suppressed too, since you said everything with the same key.

| priority | day | quiet |
|---|---|---|
| low | `email` 111 | `queue` 90 |
| normal | `push` 112 | `queue` 88 |
| high | `sms`, `email` 112 | `queue` 88 |
| critical | `pager` 200 | `pager` |

State lives in `createState`. See [src/router.js:41](src/router.js:41).

Next: nothing.
